original.target_description: Single original experiment: 88 University of North Carolina introductory psychology students rated self and average college student on traits. Located the omnibus desirability × rating-perspective interaction across four desirability levels; a separate positive-traits-only self-versus-other test was not identified. Exact target test remains uncertain from the neutral description and p.5 locator.

n.sample_role: Participants in final within-subject self/average-college-student ratings experiment
n.exclusions: No final-sample participant exclusions reported in the examined methods/results. Initial desirability and controllability rating samples are separate.

replication.target_description: Replication experiment, item-level regression of self-minus-other trait ratings on desirability, controllability, and their interaction; desirability coefficient in full model, matching p.10 Table 6. Analytic units are 149 traits, with ratings collected from separate MTurk groups.

n.sample_role: Traits/items in regression; participant ratings averaged within each trait and dimension
n.exclusions: Paper reports six participants excluded for being outside the United States (four first sample, two second); no further item exclusions reported. The 1,573 total participants are not the regression analytic n.

notes: Original exact-test ambiguity retained: supplied description emphasizes positive-trait self-versus-other descriptiveness, whereas the located test is an omnibus desirability × rating-perspective interaction across all desirability levels. Its F and p are paired, but confidence in target assignment is false. The replication authors Table 6 instead compare their desirability slope with original partial eta-squared .78; original p.1624 reports F(3,261)=306.80 for the main effect of desirability across both perspectives, a different test, so it was not substituted for the self-versus-other interaction. Original locator p.5 falls on Figure 1/discussion of controllability moderation; the relevant omnibus statistics are on PDF p.4. Original source cache contains frozen primary author-uploaded HTML method/results excerpts with OCR spacing normalized only in quotes. Replication PDF text renders equals/minus and Greek letters imperfectly; table columns were identified using headers and notes. No effect-size conversion performed.
